sections.title: P07.4 self-check
sections.text:
Candidate: `9e56afe69ef2525f7ec3a68ca3b252e6b9bf1078`; base: `9fe70584928a409b9a6377655ceaa71e4e575cc2`. Fresh independent read-only inspection of the final product: GREEN. Behavioral evidence is the canonical composite validation receipt.

| Invariant | Inspection and behavioral evidence |
|:--|:--|
| Unknown/inactive entities deny before every grant and memo | NativePermissionTest covers allowed, scopeFor, canOnRecord and query apply, including matching stale grants. |
| Native access uses its own matrix and direct grants | AccessChecker/DirectGrantLookup and PG tests cover absent/deleted roles, scope none, expiry/revocation and workspace filtering. Installed access closure has no AzGuard package or directory. |
| Compiler and bridge writes share the tenant transaction | Actual compiler binding dispatches the registered listener; bridge tests assert connection identity and transaction depth, new/existing mirror rollback and outer rollback. |
| Invalidation waits for commit and preserves original tenant | Compiler and bridge tests capture original tenant, switch context before commit, and assert no bump on rollback. |
| Bridge owns links and accesses public seams | Link migration has no foreign FK; runtime has no foreign Internal import. Public RoleMatrixData, EntityActivity and RoleMatrixCompiled connect packages. |
| Configuration remains typed and owned by bridge | Lazy immutable Options, direct SPI delegation, registration-time pins, boot validation and exactly four transferred ownership rows; configuration tests and Options singleton gate pass. |
| Public delta remains finite | Exact BC admission; all 25 Golden symbol changes belong to access/access-azguard; routes, events and wire stay unchanged. |

No unresolved current P07.4 product defect was found. The existing tasks-workflow → wakeup exception is owned by P07.5 and remains outside this item.
